linkedin:
Only 23% of 4,441 active remote jobs on Loker Dollar reveal their pay. Most listings keep compensation private—here's what the data shows.

Out of 4,441 live remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The other 3,441 (77%) stay silent on pay. Only one listing in the sample discloses a rate: Neo Financial's Remote Bilingual Client Services at $5 USD/hour. TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether all hire remotely but show no pay figure.

The good news for job seekers: 2,753 listings (about 62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world, so a location-agnostic remote role is realistic.

Skills most in demand across 4,282 analyzed listings: Communication (1,662 listings, 39%), AI (517, 12%), Leadership (416, 10%), Sales (363, 8%), Project Management (313, 7%), Data Analysis (287, 7%). AI is the fastest-growing prerequisite.

The platform hosts listings from 1,560 distinct companies. The takeaway: undisclosed pay doesn't mean low wages—many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Filter for 'worldwide remote' and apply before listings close.
